brief:
Attiyya Abu Naqira, a senior commander in the Izz ad-Din al-Qassam Brigades, died after a battle with a terminal illness, Shehab Wire reported. Known by the epithet "Lion of al-Shabura," Abu Naqira had led a military and resistance career spanning four decades against Israeli occupation.

His death marks the loss of a veteran fighter whose armed struggle extended throughout the period of Palestinian resistance operations. Abu Naqira left behind a legacy defined by decades of confrontation with occupation forces.
dek: Attiyya Abu Naqira, a senior commander in the Izz ad-Din al-Qassam Brigades, died after a battle with a terminal illness, Shehab Wire reported.
title: Qassam commander Attiyya Abu Naqira dies after prolonged illness
